title: Contact form submitters get an acknowledgement email, not only the Space owner

source.ref: Funnel follow-up email survey 2026-11-13, plan item 4: the owner is emailed on a contact form, the submitter is not

detail:
submitContactForm (every Space site contact, quote, inquiry, letter and follow form) emailed only the owner. The submitter now gets one receipt: lib/crm/contact-ack-email.ts (pure builder), lib/crm/contact-ack-io.ts (best-effort sender called beside notifyOwnerOfContactLead; suppression list honored, one per address per Space per hour via a once-claim plus an hour-bucketed outbox dedupe key). Sent from Frequency's default From; Space-name masking stays off until Daniel approves it. Done when the probe passes (door calls the sender; sender keeps suppression, limit and dedupe) and the sample is in the catalog. Not covered, deliberately: event check-in, share-back exchange and warm-intro accept send the person nothing, and the lead-magnet unlock page says it is on its way to the inbox but no email is sent. Those are separate rows.

Contact form submitters get the acknowledgement; draft PR claude/email-submitter-ack.

Probe wired as a node command.
